title: MV Manipulating the game through scripted messages?

posts.author: MS_MANGO
posts.body:
Good day. Recently, I stumbled upon this very interesting thread about scripting in messages and choices:
Game Message and Choice dynamic text code Tutorial
Messages and Choices via Scripts and Dynamic Text Codes  It has been very difficult to find an answer for this, as well as to find a cohesive explanation of choice scripting. Google searching and copy pasting always makes the console to dump an exception on you... While trying to overcome the...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
I was wondering if it's possible to do more in the scripted messages in the base RPG Maker MV, such as manipulating switches and variables and executing other script calls specifically inside $gameMessage.add(""); and in the middle of a sentence.
I tried to do it myself but couldn't.
If not, is there any non-base answer to this question?
I'm using:
RPG Maker MV 1.6.2

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
There is a plugin Hakuen Studio Message Actions in their MV museum bundle that lets you run javascript from the message box.

Though, it is sad that it's impossible to implement script calls from other plugins.

The things I'm particularly interested in right now are turning on / off a switch, changing the value of a variable and maybe doing image manipulation at any point in the text by doing it in the message.
I'm also interested in executing scriptcalls from plugins (like "Input.isEnabled = true / false;" from a plugin made by Aerosys). Though, this one is the only one I'm interested in right now.
The plugin you attached looks interesting! I will test it in a few hours as I had to leave my computer.
EDIT: It works great! I actually prefer this one more since it's one simple plugin and seemingly allows for more things to be executed with that <script> tag. Thank you!
